_readme: The legend of DJ's map 'Distribution of the Major Language Families' (Documents\Andah Main\Statistics\Distribution of the Major Language Families.png, 10000x4999, the same frame as his yearly civilisation maps): each branch's exact paint colour, read from the swatches on the map (as andah-atlas language_from_map.py reads it). scripts/build_years_commoners.py turns the map into the 1765 commoners keyframe. Override the map's path with the environment variable ANDAH_FAMILY_MAP.
